analysis.title: The Great Divide: Metals and Non-Metals
analysis.description: A dark-themed slide illustrating the division of elements on the periodic table into metals and non-metals. Bullet points introduce the concept at the top, and a stylized periodic table map below highlights non-metals in orange on the right (and hydrogen on top-left) separated by a bold white stepped dividing line from the metals, which occupy the left, centre, and bottom.
analysis.layout: The title is positioned top-left, followed directly underneath by a two-bullet explanatory text block. Below the text, taking up the majority of the slide body, is a periodic table diagram with a prominent white zigzag stair-step dividing line separating orange-highlighted non-metals on the upper right from metals labelled in cyan and dark grey/black boxes.

components.visibleText: The Great Divide: Metals and Non-Metals

• The majority of elements are metals, located on the left and centre of the map.
• Non-metals are found in a smaller cluster on the top right.
